chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Habeeb, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah formed the Prophets upon their prophethood, so they will not revert (to disbelief) ever. And He formed the Successors upon their succession, so they will not revert ever. And He formed some of the believers upon faith, so they will not revert ever. And among them is one to whom faith is lent as a loan; so when he supplicates and persists in supplication, he dies upon faith.
ai.seo_question: What are the different levels of faith permanence in Shia theology according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the ontological stability of faith (thabat al-iman) by categorizing believers into those with innate, irreversible conviction and those with temporary faith contingent upon spiritual effort. It highlights the Shia doctrine that while Prophets and Imams are divinely sealed in their station, ordinary believers may oscillate in their certainty, yet persistent supplication serves as a mechanism to solidify their faith into permanence.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Habeeb, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Formed the Prophetsas upon theiras Prophet-hood. Thus, theyas will not be reneging, ever! And Heazwj Formed the successorsas upon their successorship. Thus, theyas will not be reneging, ever! And Heazwj Moulded some of the Momineen upon the Emān. Thus they will not be reneging, ever! And from them is one to whom the Emān is Lent with a Lending. So when he supplicates and persists in the supplication, would die upon the Emān’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Qasim ibn Habib from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

‘‘Allah has formed the prophets upon their prophet-hood, thus they never, turn away therefrom. He has formed the successors of the prophets upon their successor-ship and they never turn away therefrom. He has formed certain believers upon belief and they never turn away therefrom. Belief in certain ones among them is deposited and if he prays persistently he dies upon belief.”
